請把上述資訊告訴我，謝謝！

Thus we should ask for zipcodes. Also we can ask for current fuel level. But we don't have function to get fuel level. We can ask user to input. Then we can estimate range. We can use estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage with distance. But we need distance. So we need zipcodes.

Thus answer: ask for zipcodes.')
